verdict.rationale: Xero exposes ledger data via API/SDK and an MCP server (contacts, chart of accounts, invoices) and has JAX for transaction categorization/matching, but there is no evidence of an anomaly-detection or duplicate-transaction-flagging feature, nor any documented pre-close audit/monitoring agent capability. missing for 10: anomaly detection, duplicate-transaction flagging, pre-close audit workflow, any agent-driven monitoring feature.
